verdict.rationale: Steel repeatedly describes itself as open-source, and its public steel-browser GitHub repository is an open-source browser API that ships code and a pre-built Docker image, so its source is readable. A commenter also refers to it as an open-source alternative. Missing for 10: the specific license (e.g., MIT or Apache) is never named in the evidence, and it is unclear whether managed-cloud features (stealth, CAPTCHA solving, agent traces) are part of the open codebase.
